n: Nextech unplugged CS and data science bytes
t: A K-12 set of no-computer data science activities with dice and cards.
steps: Open the Nextech CS Byte page for unplugged data science.
Check the page for the current download links and any sign-in step.
Gather seven dice or print seven numbered cards.
Read the Data Science Dice prompts.
Pick one activity that fits your grade level.
Print the sorting algorithms card deck if you plan to use it.
Run a short trial with a small group first.
